title: GIS in Agriculture: Yield and Sustainability Practices
reason: This lecture discusses various agricultural practices and their impacts on resources and the environment.

tasks.task: Discuss the role of modern agricultural practices in increasing crop yields.

subtasks.text: Mention the use of tillages and pest control practices for better crop health.
Explain the use of chemical, biological, mechanical, and cultural practices in pest control.

tasks.task: Highlight the importance of nutrient inputs and their role in crop growth.

subtasks.text: Describe the use of chemical inorganic fertilizers for better crop growth.
Discuss the role of manure in increasing crop and livestock production.

tasks.task: Examine water management practices in agriculture.

subtasks.text: Highlight the impact of insufficient water availability on crop production.
Describe the unsustainable rate of water usage in agriculture.

tasks.task: Address the issues arising from land transformation and its impact on land quality.

subtasks.text: Explain land transformation and its conversion to agricultural use.
Identify the causes and consequences of desertification.

tasks.task: Summarize the negative impacts of excessive fertilizer and pesticide use on soil.

subtasks.text: Describe the reduction in soil fertility due to excessive fertilizer use.
Explain the soil acidification and salinization caused by pesticides and fertilizers.

tasks.task: Discuss potential solutions to address agricultural challenges.

subtasks.text: Highlight the need for efficient irrigation water use.
Mention the need for water security and reducing environmental consequences.
